section_summary.extract_value: This section describes one study (no label such as 'Study 1' provided) with 369 female participants from the general population. Participants were aged 18–55 (M = 26.84, SD = 8.74) and had a mean BMI of 23.21 kg/m2 (SD = 4.90); the authors note the BMI distribution was equivalent to the female Portuguese population. No information is provided about survey method, country of recruitment, BMI assessment method (self-report vs measured), body appreciation assessment, or correlations between body appreciation and BMI.
section_summary.evidence_source: Full quoted sentences: "Participants were 369 women from general population, aged between 18 and 55  years old (M = 26.84; SD = 8.74)." "Participants' Body Mass Index (BMI) presented  a mean of 23.21 kg/m2  (SD = 4.90), which corresponds to normal weight values,  according to the conventional classification (WHO, 1995)." "Furthermore, the sample's  BMI distribution revealed to be equivalent to the female Portuguese population's  BMI distribution (Poínhos et al., 2009)."
